cohort: The study cohort consisted of 120 consecutive clinically suspected singleton IUGR pregnancies between 34-40 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found that TSH levels alone may not be a reliable biomarker for IUGR prediction, despite observing severe outcomes (stillbirth, very low birth weight, NICU admission) in babies born to a small subset of hypothyroid mothers with confirmed IUGR.
mod_finding: Two of the three babies born to hypothyroid mothers were delivered via caesarean section.
birth_weight: very low birth weights (<1.5 kg) for some cases
